questions.question: What is the minimum length of a memorized secret chosen by the subscriber?
questions.answer: A memorized secret chosen by the subscriber must be at least 8 characters in length [1].

questions.question: Should verifiers require users to change their passwords periodically?
questions.answer: No, verifiers should not require memorized secrets to be changed arbitrarily (such as periodically), unless there is evidence that the authenticator has been compromised [1].

questions.question: How many failed authentication attempts may a verifier allow before rate limiting?
questions.answer: Unless otherwise specified for a given authenticator, the verifier SHALL limit consecutive failed authentication attempts on a single account to no more than 100 [1]. Additionally, a rate-limiting mechanism is specifically required when an authentication secret, authenticator output or activation secret,, or look-up secret has less than 64 bits of entropy.

questions.question: How many layers does the encoder of the base Transformer have?
questions.answer: The encoder of the Transformer is composed of a stack of N = 6 identical layers [1].

questions.question: What BLEU score does the big Transformer reach on WMT 2014 English-to-German?
questions.answer: The big Transformer model achieves a BLEU score of 28.4 on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task [1].

questions.question: What does the calibre demo document demonstrate?
questions.answer: The calibre demo document demonstrates the ability of the calibre DOCX Input plugin to convert various typographic features in a Microsoft Word document (2007 and newer) into modern ebook formats like EPUB or AZW3 [1]. It shows support for features such as images, tables, lists, footnotes, endnotes, links, dropcaps, and different types of text and paragraph-level formatting [1].
